claim_policy: Promotion is allowed only when all ten gates are pass and every gate retains repository evidence.

gates.requirement: OmD is statistically first or tied for first on the Verified Skill Lift track.
gates.current_boundary: The fresh Luna depot matrix showed OmD 2/3 resolved but an unstable proof path. The 1.9.691 public-task transfer then made the repaired browser fallback proof-compliant in 3/3 trials with zero user handoffs, but OmD resolved 0/3 and Reliability@3 remained zero.

gates.requirement: Overall paired resolved-lift 95% lower bound is above zero with no material negative slice across at least three model families.
gates.current_boundary: Transfer calibration exists, but no current-epoch three-family confidence bound is eligible.

gates.requirement: The full harness is Pareto non-dominated for resolved rate, elapsed time, and unplanned human intervention.
gates.current_boundary: An internal three-task repeated matrix is non-dominated; frontier scale and current-epoch transfer remain incomplete.

gates.requirement: At least 24 hidden tasks cover creation, repair, state, responsive, accessibility, evidence/unknown, screenshot fidelity, open briefs, and five locales.
gates.current_boundary: The inventory has 78 public tasks and zero hidden audit-eligible tasks. A commitments-only private registry boundary exists, but no private denominator is authored.

gates.requirement: Verified rows have ten runs per task and downloadable successes, failures, timeouts, manifests, and representative artifacts.
gates.current_boundary: Hash-verified success/failure/timeout package admission exists; real 24 by 10 completed current-epoch groups remain zero.

gates.requirement: Blind review includes at least ten practitioners with confidence intervals, agreement, reversal, and both-fail rates.
gates.current_boundary: Review operations and automated triage exist; the ten-practitioner panel has not been observed.

gates.requirement: An independent task audit estimates fewer than 5% broken or ambiguous tasks and retires flagged tasks before ranking.
gates.current_boundary: All 78 public tasks pass core validation and 11 contract mutations are killed; an independent auditor sample and broken-rate estimate remain absent.

gates.requirement: Install to first resolved surface and seven-day reuse improve over 1.9.0 without accessibility, evidence-honesty, or Builder regression.
gates.current_boundary: Four-channel day-eight technical survivability and local activation pass; behavioral reuse and production lift are unobserved.

gates.requirement: Natural-language routing selects the smallest capable workflow, specialists advise with evidence, one main agent owns edits, and the same consumer route is reverified.
gates.current_boundary: The product contract and local multi-channel route loop pass. 1.9.774-776 execute the same provider-zero ready/question/blocked routing contract in installed Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode trees, recover it through safe update, and diagnose it through a fail-closed self-test. Broader repeated model-runtime proof and same-consumer-route UI re-verification remain incomplete.

gates.requirement: The harness investigates and debates before intake, auto-decides only evidence-backed reversible choices, and asks the user only for authority-bearing decisions while retaining a reconstructable decision ledger.
gates.current_boundary: The full pilot was safe but expensive; later authority calibration separated preserve-existing/defer, user-answerable/interview, and external-unverifiable/blocked. In 1.9.773 a fixed Luna/high checkpoint canary preserved the ready/interview/blocked oracle 3/3 while state routing reduced provider calls 3→1: exact registered questions and external blockers were relayed without a model, and only the ready design-judgment cell resumed the master. This is a small checkpoint canary, not fresh repeated end-to-end council effectiveness or UI-quality proof.
